item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 28/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A maritime airstream will gradually affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Temperatures will rise progressively over the region. There may be damp days over the weekend and on Monday. The weather will be humid and foggy in the morning and at night. It will be warm during the day. A cold front is expected to move across southern China on Tuesday. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon and its replenishment, temperatures will fall progressively over the region in the middle and latter parts of next week. The weather will be appreciably cooler and it will be cloudy with rain.
